component.name: OmniSign
component.summary: Sign, verify, and re-timestamp PDF documents

description.p: OmniSign is a multiplatform digital signature application for PDF documents. It produces and validates PAdES BASELINE B, B-T, B-LT, and B-LTA signatures using the EU DSS library, with full support for the EU Trusted Lists and eIDAS-compliant qualified electronic signatures.

ul.li: Sign PDFs with PKCS#11 hardware tokens or PKCS#12 keystores.
Verify existing PAdES signatures against the EU LOTL.
Re-timestamp archived signatures to extend their long-term validity.
Batch signing and renewal with profile-based configuration.
